subject.title: Telegram: specific forum topic becomes permanent inbound black hole after stuck-session recovery

question: Should this issue remain the separate canonical investigation for persistent post-restart Telegram forum-topic black holes, and what recovery boundary should release or reset a stuck topic lane safely?
rationale: The source-proven in-process lane guard does not fully explain the field evidence that one topic remains black-holed after full restarts and session deletion, and the related PR's lane-release behavior needs a maintainer-approved hard cancellation or restart boundary.

options.title: Keep Separate Persistent Topic Investigation
options.body: Keep this issue open for durable state and restart-replay proof across forum topic routing, spool, dedupe, and session recovery before closing it.

options.title: Fold Into Guarded-Lane Work After Proof
options.body: Treat the related guarded-lane issue as canonical only if maintainers confirm the same root cause explains the post-restart forum-topic behavior.

options.title: Require Hard Restart/Cancellation Contract First
options.body: Do not accept any lane-release fix until it proves the old handler is killed, isolated by process restart, or otherwise unable to race later same-lane updates.

recommendation.title: Keep Separate Persistent Topic Investigation
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for durable state and restart-replay proof across forum topic routing, spool, dedupe, and session recovery before closing it.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged Telegram isolated spool recovery work is the strongest feature-history owner trail for the timeout, reply-fence, and restart semantics under discussion.
